instructions.quote: The following accounting categories of financial assets should be considered: Financial assets at amortised cost, financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income, investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates,

financial assets designated at fair value through profit or loss and non-trading financial assets mandatorily at fair value through profit or loss, and real estate collaterals obtained by credit institutions by taking possession in exchange for cancellation of debts.
Credit institutions shall duplicate this template for reporting on stocks for the calculation of GAR stock, and reporting on new assets for the calculation of GAR flow.
Credit institutions shall duplicate this template for turnover-based and CapEx-based disclosures.

instructions.ref: Article 4(1a) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2178 as inserted by Article 1(3) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/73
instructions.quote: credit institutions may omit assessing whether the on-balance sheet assets whose use of proceeds is known are taxonomy-eligible or taxonomy-aligned where the cumulative value of those assets is below 10 %
The assets to which the first subparagraph is applied shall be reported separately as non-material assets.

instructions.ref: Article 7(2) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2178 as replaced by Article 1(6)(a) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/73
instructions.quote: Derivatives, cash and cash equivalents, on demand interbank loans, and other categories of assets that are not referred to in Article 7(6), including goodwill and commodities, shall be excluded from the denominator of key performance indicators of financial undertakings.

instructions.ref: Article 7(3), first subparagraph, as replaced by Article 1(6)(a) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/73
instructions.quote: All exposures to undertakings that are not obliged to include sustainability information in their management report pursuant to Article 19a or Article 29a of Directive 2013/34/EU,
during the financial year, shall be excluded from the denominator of key performance indicators of financial undertakings.

By way of derogation from the first subparagraph, exposures to Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) shall be included in the denominator of key performance indicators of financial undertakings where those SPVs finance:
By way of derogation from the first subparagraph, financial undertakings may include in the denominator of their key performance indicators the following exposures:

exposures to undertakings as referred to in the first subparagraph where those undertakings report on a voluntary basis the key performance indicators in accordance with Annexes I to XI to this Regulation;
exposures to undertakings referred to in the first subparagraph whose use of proceeds is known.

shall be included in the numerator of key performance indicators of financial undertakings up to the full value of taxonomy-aligned economic activities that those exposures finance, on the basis of information provided by their counterparties.

instructions.ref: Annex V, Section 1.1.2, third paragraph, as replaced by Annex V point (1) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/73
instructions.quote: The following assets shall be excluded from the numerator and the denominator of the GAR:

instructions.ref: Annex V, Section 1.1.2, third paragraph, point (c)
instructions.quote: exposures to undertakings that are not obliged to publish non-financial information pursuant to Article 19a or 29a of Directive 2013/34/EU;

instructions.ref: Annex V, Section 1.1.2, third paragraph, point (f)
instructions.quote: other categories of assets (such as goodwill, commodities, etc.).

interpretations.subject: T2 columns e-j
interpretations.reading: Columns e to j (one per environmental objective) break down the Taxonomy-aligned amount of column d by the objective the exposure's aligned activities contribute to.
interpretations.basis: The template prints the objective columns without a spanning header immediately after 'Of which Taxonomy-aligned' (column d); the aligned amount is the one the Regulation assigns to a single objective (an activity is aligned to the objective it substantially contributes to). The eligible amount is not reported by objective anywhere else in this version's Template 2.

interpretations.subject: T3 columns c-h
interpretations.reading: Columns c to h ('Breakdown per environmental objective') break down the Taxonomy-aligned proportion of column b by objective.
interpretations.basis: Columns b to k sit under one blank spanning header beside column a; column b is 'Taxonomy-aligned' and columns i to k ('Of which Use of Proceeds', 'transitional', 'enabling') are parts of the aligned amount, so the objective breakdown between them is read as a breakdown of the aligned proportion as well.
